reviews.review:
Campaign: One of the best campaigns I've ever played; strong characters such as Cpt. Titus and Lt. Mira and a great story.
It handles as it should, you're a 7ft man in heavy armour with giant weapons, you feel practically invincible. The Campaign is fantastic and true to the Warhammer 40k universe/lore.
Jei's rating: 8.4/10

Online multiplayer:
*sigh* P2P, no dedicated servers; if you're in Australia, give my regards to the lag demon.
Could have been so much more with dedicated servers, however THQ did not listen to the comunity. That was also their downfall, no listening or market research... moving on.
When you are not experiencing lag, the online multiplayer is a lot of fun.
The online multiplayer was also riddled with DLC; players had to buy more maps and game modes.
Because of P2P and the rediculous DLC I give the Online Multiplayer a rating of 4.1/10.
----------------------------------------------------------------
Eternal Crusade:  'Planetside 2 + Space Marine'
https://www.eternalcrusade.com/
Referral code: EC-JLE5E148FKH5W

Man, I love WH40k universe.

This game delivers a very good feeling about it. Good graphics and lots of blood.
The campaign is interesting, although it has almost the same cliches with previous titles. No spoil for more information about it. I also liked that it lasted long enough to enjoy it and not got bored or left unsatisfied upon finishing it. 

The music adds nicely to the atmosphere and generally the audio effects and the voices are great.

The gameplay is also well putted. The controls are easily learned, but during the game it may get a little bit annoying at some points (slow or no response at all on some critical situations or getting blocked by silly obstacles).
The saving is done automatically through checkpoints.

Pros & Cons that I think they are worthy to be mentioned:

+ Some nice scenes. Other at open places with distant view and others underground, delivering a claustrophobic feeling.
+ Cool battles at some places, where there are your fellow Space Marines, Imperial Forces, Orcs and/or Chaos forces mixed up and fighting at each other. Even better when you open your way by charging among them.
+ Great animations during execution acts.
+ No loading screens between areas or minimal time after switching acts in the campaign.
+ Variety of weapons.
+ The game delivers a similar feeling with other mosterpieces like Dawn of War 1 and 2.
+ Killing tons of Orcs is so much fun. And after all this gore, your armor is covered with blood.
+ Many times, it felt like playing Dawn of War but at a third person view. Specially, when you charge towards with other Space Marines.
+ Cool customization options in multiplayer mode. The various DLC's are a good addition, but as I hate the whole idea with DLC's at games, I would recommend them only with a bundle pack of the game or something, as you may get them with discount or for free by that way.

- During intense battles you may get confused with the keys and lose.
- No option to skip scenes, which may get annoying especially at points when you lose and restart from last checkpoint and you have to wait for a cutscene again.
- You can overpass some small obstacles.
- No custom saves.
Not the most innovative shooter, but an absolutely glorious, macho adventure in pulverizing orks and converting space-heathens.

Short Campaign, repetetive gameplay... I can't say I had a lot of fun with this game. Although I haven't played as much as I should to give a good review, I'll say this: If your the type of player that won't get bored of doing the same thing over and over again, then you might have fun with this, but I personally did not.
best warhammer game ever apart from the rts games of course but still good
